product_profile.summary: The specification establishes a rear lamp module for an M1 passenger car that integrates rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions plus a retro-reflector and outer lens in one housing, and lists representative (unconfirmed) materials for each component. No drawings were supplied. Nothing is established about voltage, photometry, colour standards, mounting position and dimensions, light-source replaceability, device categories, or approval status, all of which would drive regulatory applicability.

draft_requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a rear position lamp or rear end-outline marker lamp shall meet the requirements of Table 4: for categories R1, MR or RM1 (steady) a minimum luminous intensity of 4 cd, a maximum luminous intensity of 17 cd when used as a single lamp and 8.5 cd when used as a lamp marked "D"; for categories R2 or RM2 (variable) a minimum luminous intensity of 4 cd, a maximum luminous intensity of 42 cd when used as a single lamp and 21 cd when used as a lamp marked "D"; with the standard light distribution according to Figure A3-I in both cases.
draft_requirements.applicability_condition: Rear position lamps of categories R1, R2, MR and rear end-outline marker lamps of categories RM1, RM2; the applicable row depends on whether the lamp is steady (R1, MR, RM1) or variable (R2, RM2) and the applicable maximum depends on whether the lamp is a single lamp or a lamp marked "D" per paragraph 3.3.2.5.2.
draft_requirements.applicability_reason: The product integrates a rear position lamp function, which is covered by paragraph 5.2; which row and which maximum column apply cannot be fixed because the device category (R1/R2/MR) and "D" marking status are not established.
exceptions: A luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd is permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane (paragraph 5.2.1)
